drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, au crayon, un petit croquis : une nappe en parallélogramme marquée $X$, traversée de trois traits dans le sens de sa hauteur et de courts traits épais dans l'autre sens, avec $K'$ près de son bord inférieur et $S$ à son coin supérieur droit ; à gauche, une verticale ponctuée de petites boucles descend jusqu'à un $S$.
drawings.kind: sheet (parallelogram) over a base line, with fibres
drawings.notes: Left margin, faint pencil. A tilted parallelogram (the sheet X) on four vertices placed once; three lines across it, roughly parallel to its right side, each ending on computed points of the upper and lower sides; eight short heavy strokes across these lines (on the upper side, in the middle and on the lower side); the letter X inside, K' near the lower side, S beside the upper right corner; from the lower left corner a loop going down to the left; at the far left a long vertical line with five small curls along it, ending at a letter S. Still differs: the pencil is faint and the sketch crowded; the heavy cross strokes are placed by eye and their number is a reading; the small curls on the vertical are drawn as short ticks; what the cross strokes stand for (the points over K_1, K_2?) is not settled. Nothing struck. The long vertical stroke to the right of the sketch borders the definition and is not drawn. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
